Placemaker.UI.About: Choose an area, choose what it becomes.
Placemaker.UI.Add.Nothing: Nothing can be added to this layer.
Placemaker.UI.Add.Tip: Mix and match: add a playground, a fountain, edge zoning… or fill parts of the area with something else.
Placemaker.UI.AnarchyTip: Build even where the game reports a collision (Anarchy mod).
Placemaker.UI.Area.Adjust: Drag corners to adjust. You can change the shape at any time, even later.
Placemaker.UI.Area.Corners: {0} corners — close the outline to continue
Placemaker.UI.Area.How: How do you want to choose the area?
Placemaker.UI.Area.HowBlock: Click a city block. Shift+click adds the next one.
Placemaker.UI.Area.HowDraw: Click corners on the map, then click the first corner to finish.
Placemaker.UI.Area.HowPaint: Paint over the map with the left mouse button; the right one erases.
Placemaker.UI.Area.HowPerimeter: Click the intersections around the area, one after another.
Placemaker.UI.Arrangement.Hint: Repeats in this order along the edges
Placemaker.UI.Building.Hint: Placing roads, surfaces and objects. You can keep playing.
Placemaker.UI.Building.Title: Building…
Placemaker.UI.LauncherTip: Choose an area and turn it into a park, plaza, parking lot, streets… or your own mix.
Placemaker.UI.LockedHint: You set this yourself, so Randomize leaves it alone. Click to let Randomize change it again.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.CantEdit: This was built by an older version and can only be removed.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.Hover: Hover or click something you built with Placemaker to edit or remove it.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.RemoveText: Everything Placemaker built here (paths, surfaces, objects, roads it added) is bulldozed. Buildings that grew next to it stay.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.Title: Built with Placemaker
Placemaker.UI.Markers.Banner: Click on the outline to place, right-click to remove
Placemaker.UI.Markers.BannerFor: Placing {0} — click on the outline. Right-click one to remove it.
Placemaker.UI.Markers.Hint: Click on the outline to add one, right-click one to remove it.
Placemaker.UI.Mock.Timeout: Planning took too long and was stopped.
Placemaker.UI.Mode.BlockTip: Hover a city block and click to take it. Shift+click adds neighbouring blocks.
Placemaker.UI.Mode.DrawTip: Click corners on the map; click the first corner to close. Snaps to curbs, buildings and right angles. Drag corners or edges to adjust.
Placemaker.UI.Mode.PaintTip: Hold left mouse to paint the area, right mouse to erase.
Placemaker.UI.Mode.PerimeterTip: Click road intersections around the area, one after another, to follow existing roads exactly.
Placemaker.UI.NoSettings: Nothing to set up here: it adapts to the area by itself.
Placemaker.UI.Permanent.Terraform: The terrain is reshaped (for example dug out for a pond). Removing it later does not restore the ground.
Placemaker.UI.PickRecipe: Pick what this area should become.
Placemaker.UI.Picker.AutoMixHint: None selected: a fitting mix is chosen for you
Placemaker.UI.RandomizeTip: Rolls a new variation. Values you set yourself (marked with a lock) are kept.
Placemaker.UI.Reason.Errors: Fix the problems listed above first
Placemaker.UI.Reason.Manage: Edit or remove it above, or start a new area
Placemaker.UI.Reason.NoArea: Draw, pick or paint an area on the map first
Placemaker.UI.Reason.NotClosed: Close the outline: click the first corner again
Placemaker.UI.Reason.NotReady: Some layers still need your input
Placemaker.UI.Regions.Title: Make one {0} different
Placemaker.UI.RemoveOverride: Back to the same as the others
Placemaker.UI.Review.AckFirst: Tick the box to confirm the permanent changes first
Placemaker.UI.Review.AllGood: No problems found. Press Build when you're happy.
Placemaker.UI.Review.CantAfford: You can't afford this yet. Make it smaller or simpler, or wait for more money.
Placemaker.UI.Review.Reassure: Not quite right? Click Design or Area above — nothing is lost.
Placemaker.UI.SaveRecipe.Placeholder: Name, e.g. Corner park with café
Placemaker.UI.SaveRecipeTip: Keeps this whole design (layers and settings) as a new entry in the Make row.
Placemaker.UI.Stage.BackTip: Nothing is lost: your area and design are kept.
